## Checklist before requesting review

- [ ] Formatted with `cargo fmt`
- [ ] Clippy passes: `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] Tests pass: `cargo test`
- [ ] Both apps need this change, and it behaves the same on both ("What belongs here" in `README.md`)
- [ ] No code is copied or adapted from GPL-licensed sources
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased` if an app would notice the change
